description: This file contains Angular components and directives for a customizable popover UI element, including the implementation of TbPopoverDirective and TbPopoverComponent, with features like dynamic content, placement, overlay handling, and animations.

classes.name: TbPopoverDirective
classes.description: Angular directive managing popover behavior, including trigger handling, dynamic component creation, and property updates.

classes.name: TbPopoverComponent
classes.description: Angular component representing the popover UI, handling display, positioning, content projection, animations, and interactions.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the popover, creating the component if necessary.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the popover.

methods.name: updatePosition
methods.description: Updates the position of the popover overlay.

methods.name: createComponent
methods.description: Creates and initializes the popover component dynamically.

methods.name: registerTriggers
methods.description: Sets up event listeners based on the trigger type (hover, focus, click).

methods.name: updatePropertiesByChanges
methods.description: Syncs directive input changes to the popover component properties.

methods.name: updatePropertiesByKeys
methods.description: Updates specific properties on the popover component based on changed inputs.

methods.name: updateComponentValue
methods.description: Assigns a value to a property on the popover component.

methods.name: delayEnterLeave
methods.description: Handles delayed show/hide on hover events.

methods.name: removeTriggerListeners
methods.description: Removes all event listeners for trigger handling.

methods.name: clearTogglingTimer
methods.description: Clears the hover delay timer.

methods.name: closeButtonClick
methods.description: Handles click on the close button inside the popover.

methods.name: doShow
methods.description: Performs the actual display logic for the popover.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the popover with optional animation.

methods.name: onPositionChange
methods.description: Handles overlay position changes.

methods.name: updateStyles
methods.description: Updates CSS classes based on placement and visibility.

methods.name: setOriginElement
methods.description: Sets the origin element for overlay positioning.

methods.name: onClickOutside
methods.description: Handles clicks outside the popover to close it if configured.

methods.name: onComponentChange
methods.description: Handles updates when the embedded component inside the popover changes.

methods.name: animationDone
methods.description: Signals completion of the popover's open/close animation.

methods.name: isTopOverlay
methods.description: Determines if the clicked overlay is the topmost overlay.

methods.name: updateVisibilityByContent
methods.description: Hides the popover if content is empty.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the popover content is empty.
